text: Alta banka a.d. Beograd's sole shareholder is Alta Group d.o.o. Beograd, holding 100% of its shares (named Alta Pay Group d.o.o. when it bought the bank's entire 2024 share issue); press reports identify Serbian businessman Davor Macura as the owner of Alta Pay Group.
short: Alta banka's sole shareholder is Alta Group d.o.o. Beograd (formerly Alta Pay Group).

source.name: Nova ekonomija: Alta banka emisijom akcija uvećala kapital za 27 miliona evra
source.quote: sve novoizdate akcije kupio je jedini akcionar Alta banke, Alta Pay Group
source.note: The same article states Alta Pay is owned by Serbian businessman Davor Macura. The bank's audited 2025 annual report (additional source) records that the sole shareholder is now ALTA Group doo Beograd with 100% ownership.

additionalSources.name: Alta banka a.d. Beograd: Godišnji finansijski izveštaji za 2025. godinu sa izveštajem revizora za Banku (audited 2025 annual report)
additionalSources.quote: Učešće ALTA Group doo Beograd u ukupnom akcijskom kapitalu Banke iznosi na dan 31. decembra 2025. godine 100.00%
additionalSources.note: Audited annual report for 2025, published on altabanka.rs (Finansijski izveštaji u 2025. godini); the shareholder-structure note records ALTA Group doo Beograd as holding 100.00% of the bank's share capital on 31 December 2025 (the 2024 comparative names ALTA PAY Group doo Beograd, before the rename).
